description: All-in-One omni-agent-traderx - all-in-one agent for MoltForest on Monad: regime-aware BEAR inverse hedging, multi-asset routing, Muse portfolio layer, x402 micropayments. Fully functional: live paths activate on the operator's own env credentials.

erc8004.registration: implemented - register(string) calldata built in code, EIP-155 signed, submitted via eth_sendRawTransaction to MONAD_RPC_URL (erc8004_register)
erc8004.reputation_feedback: implemented - selector computed in code from REPUTATION_FEEDBACK_SIGNATURE (erc8004_reputation_feedback)

name: omni-agent-traderx
posture: Fully functional all-in-one Monad agent. Live paths activate on your own credentials (env); the offline demo + test-vector suite verifies every flow without them.

signer.scheme: secp256k1 ECDSA (RFC6979), EIP-191 personal-sign over receiptDigest
signer.test_key_note: demo receipts are signed with the TEST KEY (private key = 1) when AGENT_SIGNER_KEY is unset
